crossRefs.note: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

parallels.note: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword…
That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and…

translations.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
translations.asv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
